newsitem.title: USA: Career Horizons buys TSG Professional. [CORRECTED 17:50 GMT 20/9]
newsitem.headline: Career Horizons buys TSG Professional. [CORRECTED 17:50 GMT 20/9]

text.p: Career Horizons said Thursday it had bought TSG Professional Services Inc for an undisclosed amount of money.

Career Horizons, which will merge into AccuStaff Inc by the end of the year, said the purchase of the information technology provider was expected to be accretive to both its and AccuStaff's earnings in the fourth quarter of the calendar year.

The purchase would also increase the combined company's revenues in the information technology services business to more than $450 million and closer to its near-term goal of revenues of $500 million by the end of 1996. (Corrects to clarify that the revenue goal is for the combined company)
AccuStaff provides staffing, consulting and outsourcing services to clients in the public and private sector.
